visual_action: A montage of three clips of Donald Trump speaking at a desk is shown, with text overlaid. This is followed by a clip of the character President Snow from 'The Hunger Games' reading a card. The video ends with a still image of Donald Trump in a red 'MAKE AMERICA' hat looking upwards.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: He is featured in all of the video clips except one, and the on-screen text attributes a quote about 'Patriot Games' to him.

on_screen_text.text: In the fall, we will host the first-ever Patriot Games.
An unprecedented four-day athletic event featuring the greatest high school athletes...
...one young man and one young woman from each state and territory.

spoken_summary: There is no spoken dialogue in the video. The only audio is a song. On-screen text attributes quotes to Donald Trump about creating a 'Patriot Games'.
audio_music: The song 'The Hanging Tree' from 'The Hunger Games' plays throughout the video, creating an ominous and dystopian mood.
editing_pacing: Slow cuts between a set of static images of Trump, a movie clip, and a final still photo.
cultural_references: Jennifer Lawrence (as the singer of the song)
Donald Sutherland (actor who plays President Snow)
central_claim: The video compares Donald Trump's proposed 'Patriot Games' to the deadly 'Hunger Games' from the dystopian film series, implying his idea is fascistic and dangerous.
intended_effect: To make the viewer associate Donald Trump with the tyrannical regime from 'The Hunger Games' and feel alarm and opposition towards his proposal.
